violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM ON SITE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE A CFM IS ON SITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION INCLUDING DURING PREPARATION. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: REFRIGERATORS, MICROWAVE, GRILL LINE, UNDER COUNTERS.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE CLEAN AND MAINTAIN AN APPROPRIATE CLEANING SCHEDULE. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.observation: Observed that the FLOORS AND WALLS in the KITCHEN ARE in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE CLEAN AND IMPLEMENT AN APPROPRIATE CLEANING SCHEDULE. PAY ATTENTION TO AREAS UNDER 3 COMPARTMENT SINK, UNDER COUNTERS. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: CONDIMENT CONTAINERS USED AS SCOOPS TO DISPENSE FOODS IN AVANTCO 2 DOOR PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: DISHWASHING MACHINE IN KITCHEN UNABLE TO DISPENSE SANITIZER AT 50-200PPM AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO USE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK TO SANITIZE DISHES UNTIL UNIT IS REPAIRED AND CAN SANITIZE DISHES AT 50-200PPM. EMAIL EHS ONCE REPAIR IS COMPLETED.

violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PLEASE REPAIR AND EMAIL EHS ONCE REPAIR IS COMPLETED.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: OBSERVED FOOD TRAYS IN QUATERNARY AMMONIUM SANITIZER SOLUTION AT 0PPM IN 3 COMPARTMENT SINK. CHEMICAL DISPENSER WAS UNABLE TO DISPENSE SANITIZER AT TIME OF INSPECTION..
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO PREPARE BLEACH/CHLORINE SANITIZER SOLUTION OF CONCENTRATION 50-200 PPM TO SANITIZE DISHES AND KITCHENWARE UNTIL DISPENSER HAS BEEN REPAIRED.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean Every 24 Hours
violations.observation: Surfaces of the ICE MACHINE are not being cleaned as required.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours for iced tea dispensers and consumer self-service utensils such as tongs, scoops, or ladles. EDUCATION PROVIDED. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION. MUSTANG SALLY BREWERY (Inspection Date: 06/13/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: CHILI AT 120F IN STEAM TABLE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REHEAT TO 165F OR ABOVE DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticide, Conditions of use
violations.observation: Restricted, commercial use pesticides present in the facility are applied by the operator who is not a certified pesticide applicator. OBSERVED SELF APPLIED OPEN COCKROACH TRAPS IN BREWERY SERVICE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Because of their toxicity, restricted use pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE PROVIDE ONLY CERTIFIED PEST CONTROL SERVICE FOR ESTABLISHMENT.

violations.title: RTE TCS Commercially Processed Food, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is commercially processed is not used or discarded within 24 hours of when the original container was opened and is not observed to be date marked: OBSERVED CHILI AND CHEESE SAUCE IN MIGALI 2 DOOR UPRIGHT UNIT HELD FOR MORE THAN 24 HOURS WITHOUT DATE MARKING.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety commercially processed foods when opened and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of the original container was opened. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. This date cannot exceed any manufacturer determined 'use-by' date based on food safety. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EMPLOYEE APPLIED LABEL WITH APPROPRIATE DATE DURING INSPECTION.
